title: eng hiring & onboarding — interview debriefs + weekly sync (2026-04-14)
summary: Weekly sync covering interview debriefs for Platform Eng candidates, status of offers/start dates, onboarding tasks for new hires, and team health check-ins.
body:
Attendees: Liam (owner), Aisha (recruiter), Marcos (hiring manager), Sofia (mentor/buddy coordinator), Priya (SRE rep)

TL;DR:
- Two on-site debriefs completed this week; recommend move-to-offer for Candidate B, keep Candidate A in loop for second system-design loop.
- Offer accepted by Senior Infra Eng (candidate C) — tentative start 2026-05-12; provisioning checklist underway.
- Onboarding readiness: laptop imaging delayed (procurement SLA) — need backup loaner plan for 2 hires starting 5/12 and 5/19.
- Team health: bandwidth tight on releases; call-outs for doc debt and pairing time.

Interview Debriefs (summary + consensus):
1) Candidate A (Backend infra) — 2026-04-13 (onsite loop)
   - Interviewers: Marcos, Priya, Sofia
   - Strengths: strong systems thinking, good latency/cost trade-off reasoning, solid Python + C++ background.
   - Weaknesses: equivocal on distributed KV cache failure modes, needs concrete examples of debugging production GPU memory issues.
   - Hiring committee sentiment: 6/10 — recommend follow-up with ops-focused system-design (30–45m) to probe troubleshooting.
   - Action: Marcos to schedule second loop (system-design + incident postmortem) with Candidate A by 2026-04-20.

2) Candidate B (Runtime engineer) — 2026-04-12 (onsite loop)
   - Interviewers: Marcos, Sofia, Liam
   - Strengths: demonstrated low-level optimizations, good test-driven approach, previous experience shipping quantization features.
   - Weaknesses: limited infra ownership examples (mostly feature-focused).
   - Hiring committee sentiment: 8/10 — strong fit for current runtime work.
   - Recommendation: move-to-offer (pending reference check).
   - Action: Aisha to kick off reference checks and draft offer by 2026-04-16.

3) Candidate C (Senior Infra Engineer) — earlier pipeline (offer accepted 2026-04-10)
   - Start date: tentative 2026-05-12
   - Onboarding notes: prefers macOS laptop, will need HSM/KMS access scoped for Private deployments later in Q3.
   - Action: Sofia to assign buddy + first-week onboarding schedule by 2026-04-21. Marcos to add initial 30/60/90 goals to their profile.

Pipeline snapshot:
- Open reqs: Runtime (2), Serving Runtime Senior (1), SRE (1) — actively interviewing, target fill Q2.
- Offers outstanding: Candidate B (pending), Candidate D (SRE) — verbal interest; awaiting formal offer approval.
- Time-to-offer avg (last 6 hires): 32 days. Need to speed up reference checks and compensation approvals.

Onboarding readiness checklist (gaps / blockers):
- Hardware provisioning: procurement backlog — 2 laptops not imaged; risk to 5/12 start. (Owner: Ops / cc: Sofia)
- Accounts & access: infra infra-team ok; need KMS onboarding steps added to Confluence playbook (Owner: Marcos).
- Training plan: first-week deep-dive sessions scheduled (runtime architecture, perf profiling, observability). Mentor assignments: Sofia -> Candidate C; TBD -> Candidate B.
- Documentation updates: onboarding checklist in repo missing 'KV cache metrics' doc link — Marcos to fill by 2026-04-18.

Team health notes:
- Morale: general sense of fatigue during release; requests for more protected pairing time.
- Capacity: two engineers on rotation for on-call, one out on parental leave starting 4/20. Need temporary coverage — consider contractor or re-scope Q2 feature work.
- Wins: achieved 99.95% infra uptime last sprint; reduced median token latency by 6% on main path (shoutout to runtime team).
- Risks: continuous hiring + ramping new folks may slow feature velocity; balance onboarding intensity vs. delivery commitments.

Action items (owners + due dates):
- Aisha: complete reference checks + draft offer for Candidate B — due 2026-04-16.
- Marcos: schedule Candidate A second loop (system-design) — due 2026-04-20.
- Sofia: assign buddies and publish first-week schedule for Candidate C — due 2026-04-21.
- Ops (cc Sofia): confirm loaner laptop availability or expedite imaging — due 2026-04-20.
- Marcos: add KMS/HSM onboarding steps to Confluence playbook and link to onboarding checklist — due 2026-04-18.
- Eng Leads: review on-call coverage plan for parental leave (starts 2026-04-20) — meeting scheduled 2026-04-15.

Open questions / things to decide:
- Do we hire a contractor to cover on-call/backfill until SRE req filled? (Cost vs. velocity tradeoff)
- Should we reduce scope for Q2 runtime features to provide more pairing time for new hires? Proposal due 2026-04-17.

Notes to self / informal items:
- Recruiter note: comp band for Runtime levels updated last week — keep offers within band, escalate exceptions to Finance.
- Slack thread: see #eng-hiring 2026-04-13 for Candidate B interview clips.
- Reminder: re-run onboarding survey after new hires complete week 1; use quick pulse for qualitative signals.

Next sync: 2026-04-21 (same time). Please update this doc with any status changes before EOD 2026-04-16.

---
Raw/working notes (scratch):
- Candidate A: asked about KV cache LRU; candidate answered conceptual but didn't mention eviction cascades — follow up Qs for next loop.
- Candidate B: pair-programmed small perf microbench; very efficient.
- Candidate C: asked about Redwood Private use-cases — good enterprise security background, helpful for Private roadmap.

End of notes.
